title: Military Clinic Right of First Refusal on TRICARE Prime Requests for Referrals and Authorizations
content:
For a TRICARE Prime request under **Referrals and Authorizations** of a type whose right of first refusal applies, a military hospital or clinic in the patient's residence service area that offers the requested specialty has the type's response window, in business days, to accept the patient.

## Outcomes

- **The military clinic accepts.** The servicing provider becomes the military clinic, with the servicing change recorded for the reason "military clinic right of first refusal", and the patient is seen there. A Prime enrollee who goes to the civilian provider instead is under point-of-service.
- **The military clinic declines, or does not answer in time.** The network provider requested stays the servicing provider.
- **Other plans.** The right of first refusal never applies under TRICARE Select or the premium-based plans.

## Outcome table

| Plan of the request | Type's right of first refusal applies | Military clinic in the residence service area offers the specialty | Clinic's answer within the window | Servicing provider |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Prime | yes | yes | accepts | the military clinic |
| TRICARE Prime | yes | yes | declines | the network provider requested |
| TRICARE Prime | yes | yes | no answer in time | the network provider requested |
| TRICARE Select or a premium-based plan | any | any | not applicable | the right of first refusal never applies |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A TRICARE Prime Specialty Care Referral is requested to a network cardiologist, and the military clinic in the patient's residence service area offers cardiology. If the clinic accepts within its window, the patient is seen at the clinic; were the patient to go to the network cardiologist instead, the care would be under point-of-service.
